title: OUMV Conformance Report
description: Machine-readable certification artifact (spec §10.3). A runtime MUST NOT claim a conformance level without a report of this shape produced by a reproducible passing run.

adapterName.description: Stable adapter identifier, e.g. go-gin, go-chi, go-stdhttp, python-fastapi, tokensafe-ui-react.

framework.description: Underlying framework/technology, e.g. gin, chi, net/http, fastapi, react, solid.

specVersion.description: OUMV protocol version the run certified against.

fixtureVersion.description: Version of fixtures/conformance-cases.json that was executed.

attainedLevel.description: Highest cumulative level whose cases all passed. 0 means no level is claimed.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the run.

commit.description: Optional VCS revision the report was produced from.

levelStatus.description: A level with any skipped or failed case is not 'passed'.
